criteria.Writing code:
With guidance and support from more senior engineers, writes code with testability, decoupling and readability in mind, following style guides and naming conventions and accounting for edge cases and errors
Commits and pushes frequently during development process, including meaningful messages
Follows existing examples when pointed to them
When using unfamiliar code patterns, shows curiosity and seeks understanding
Learns from previous feedback - senior engineers do not have to repeatedly leave the same comments during pairing or on their pull requests
Actively participates in pairing/mobbing sessions, making sure they understand everything even if they don't drive the session
criteria.Testing:
Understands the basics about the test pyramid.
Writes primarily unit tests with some help from other engineers
Always writes tests for the happy path scenarios
Adapts test driven approach under guidance from more senior engineers
criteria.Incident response & Debugging:
Understands the basics of debugging and the tools used for it.
Shadows more senior engineers during incidents to get better familiarity with their systems
criteria.Observability: Is aware of monitoring in their system and can understand the operational data generated by the application they work on.
criteria.Software Design & System Architecture:
Understand the design of at least one service.
Designs and writes basic functions for this service, avoiding duplication and interface breaking changes
criteria.Cloud Infra: Is familiar with the basic building blocks, e.g. understands k8s manifests, can write terraform scripts using existing modules, and knows how the CI/CD pipeline works.
criteria.Security: Understands that security is critical part of building a successful, scalable and maintainable product and technology.
criteria.Work breakdown:
Follows tasks set out by more senior engineers
Understands value of rightsizing tasks to enable continuous integration and incremental delivery.

criteria.Writing code:
Consistently writes code that is easily testable, decoupled, easily understood by other developers, following style guides and naming conventions and accounting for edge cases and errors
Favours simplicity in code wherever possible
Able to find working examples in known existing codebases and follow them to achieve similar results on another task
Makes good use of supplementary tools (IDE, command line), including refactoring the code when needed
Commits and pushes frequently during development process, including meaningful messages
Regularly participates in pairing/mobbing sessions, ensuring balanced proportion of driving the session and not
criteria.Testing:
Understands all levels of testing in the testing pyramid
Writes tests in accordance with it, sometimes with help from more senior engineers (particularly for higher-level tests)
Tests happy path scenarios and identifies and tests expected edge cases and errors
Writes most code as test-driven development
criteria.Incident response & Debugging:
Uses a systematic approach to debug issues located within a single service. 
Is able to deal with incidents with the aid of runbooks. 
Uses our observability stack to concisely articulate the issue using collected observability data points.
criteria.Observability:
Is aware of the organization's monitoring philosophy and the operational data for their team.
Adds appropriate metrics and logging, creates dashboards and alerts according to team standards
criteria.Software Design & System Architecture:
Understands the design of all services that the team owns.
Deep expertise and understanding of at few of them
Designs and writes functions for multiple services, avoiding duplication and taking into account overall architecture
criteria.Cloud Infra:
Is fully capable of operating well-explored and frequently-used cloud offerings by their team.
Understands the standard delivery tooling (e.g. Kubernetes/ArgoCD) in order to effectively deliver and operate their products
criteria.Security: Actively assesses the risk of all engineering operations, code and technology and takes action to address or raise with senior members of the team.
criteria.Work breakdown:
Breaks down stories into tasks ready for coding
Before beginning work, ensures that tasks are appropriately sized for continuous integration and incremental delivery with help from teammates and manager.

criteria.Writing code:
Writes code and designs the applications that are scalable and highly resilient
Competent in chosen tech stack but may need help from more senior engineers on the complex / nuanced topics
Assembles working code for unknown problems from incomplete, separate examples (other repos/codebases, tutorials, stackoverflow and similar), focusing on understanding of the resulting solution
Frequently leaves the code in a better state than before (boy scout rule), reviews the state of the application they are working on to identify potential improvements to add to backlog
Challenges guidelines and proposes improvements where appropriate.
Understands when it is appropriate to leave comments, but biases towards self-documenting code
Understands git model and can resolve gitastrophes
criteria.Testing:
Understands all levels of testing in the testing pyramid
Writes unit tests as well as higher level tests in accordance with it, also identifying when techniques such as mocking are/are not appropriate.
Always writes tests to handle happy paths scenarios, as well as expected edge cases and errors
Writes most code as test-driven development
Regularly validates functional and non-functional requirements of the developed system, including manual/exploratory and performance testing where appropriate
criteria.Incident response & Debugging:
Resolves incidents within the team responsibilities as needed and is comfortable fixing production issues independently. Proficient at using systematic debugging to diagnose all issues located in the teams' services and identifies cross-team/cross-services issues.
Shares knowledge through runbooks.
Contributes to PostMortems in a blameless, constructive manner.
Communicates clearly within the team and with TechOps, clarifying root causes and remediations.
criteria.Observability:
Understands and applies organization's monitoring philosophy and the operational data for their team.
Correctly identifies relevant metrics and logging patterns to be applied by their team
Sets conventions for dashboards and alerts for metrics relevant in the team
criteria.Software Design & System Architecture:
Expert at all their team's services, their design and works productively within it. 
Consistently designs code that is aligned with the overall service architecture. Utilizes abstractions and code isolation effectively.
Understands and applies common patterns for building decoupled, scalable, highly available applications, including different technical approaches such as:
* synchronous and asynchronous communication
* REST/RPC vs messaging
* topics vs queues
* push vs pull communication
Understands different data storage solutions
Designs system domain boundaries to avoid leaking internal knowledge or implementation details across teams, domains and products.
Guides their team in the implementation of these system boundaries and other teams in the integration with the services provided.
criteria.Cloud Infra:
Provisions all of the standard cloud infrastructure to support work on features/ epics.
Is competent at planning and provisioning infrastructure that is tried and tested within the team
Is familiar with cloud networking and more advanced topics.
Can assess solutions from a cost perspective, building cost forecasts for the intended use and continuously keep track of cost to ensure effective resource utilization within budget.
Understands differences between serverless and traditional deployments, as well as managed vs unmanaged offering
criteria.Security: Approaches all engineering work with a security lens. Actively looks for security vulnerabilities both in the code and when providing peer reviews.  Is forming a solid understanding of threat modelling and mentors other members of the team in this regard.
criteria.Work breakdown:
Breaks down epics into stories
Reviews tasks critically and ensures they’re appropriately sized for continuous integration and incremental delivery.
